correctness_cases.name: preserve_event_and_group_author_byte_preservation
correctness_cases.reason: Correctness fix preserves an already equivalent author record instead of rebuilding its dictionary order. No global comparator normalization.

method.comparison: var_to_bytes entire return; no exclusions, normalization, rounding or sorted fields
method.other_dependencies: All other helpers remain shared and are recorded by SHA. This proves only the road_tools/terrain_projection/road_terrain_fit change boundary.
method.reference: Frozen original road_tools -> frozen original adaptive fit -> byte-identical original projection. Only recorded single preload substitutions redirect this chain.
method.scope: In-memory CPU preparation and exact geometry/errors/state. No native publication, save/reopen, HTTP, GPU or traversal claim.
method.type: strict CPU differential, not a timing run

reference_manifest.scope: Exact pre-optimization projection and adaptive fit; only two explicit preload path adaptations create independent original prepare chain
